F3 exponent drift: beta_obs drifts outside [5.0, 7.0] over a multi-year period

claim_summary: F4 Metcalfe fit: Metcalfe R-squared sustained below 0.7
F5 R-squared collapse: rolling 3-year R-squared of the price power law below 0.80 for more than two consecutive years
notes: Live and computable. No public party is currently running it.

claim_summary: A power-law floor break means two consecutive weekly closes below the floor as published by a named tracker, with the tracker and its parameterization named in advance
resolution_basis: Newhedge power law floor, genesis-block origin, exponent ~5.8
notes: Self-entry. Pre-commits that a break of that rail is the falsification of a parameterization, not of the power law, because it does not meet F1. Published before the outcome was known.
